pains.title: Model suitability across multi-step agents
pains.statement: Potential pressure: selecting suitable models for different Agent Builder steps while preserving useful behavior across a branching workflow.

evidence.claim: Glean Agent Builder documents branching, looping and model selection per step.
Glean already offers managed model selection and its own governed AI Gateway; this is existing-control counterevidence.

cost_of_inaction.statement: Supported inference: an unsuitable model choice could require additional validation and rework or reduce the usefulness of an agent step. No observed unresolved compatibility defect or financial loss was established.

why_seller.statement: OpenRouter exposes multiple models and parameter-aware provider routing, which could be evaluated for a specific uncovered workload. It does not supply Glean-specific evaluations or prove a replacement is needed.

pains.title: Cost and quality allocation across growing agent use
pains.statement: Potential pressure: aligning model cost and quality with department and agent usage, while respecting existing access and usage limits.

evidence.claim: Glean markets visibility and monthly limits across departments, users, models and agents.
Glean Universal Model Key Auto already balances quality and cost using evaluations and live usage.

cost_of_inaction.statement: Supported inference: poorly matched model choices or limits could make capacity allocation harder or constrain useful agent work. No overrun, budget amount or quantified savings was established.

why_seller.statement: OpenRouter documents price-aware provider selection and maximum-price constraints. Relevance depends on a gap Glean’s current routing and usage controls leave; generic missing-cost-control positioning is unsupported.

pains.title: Different operational responsibility in customer-key deployments
pains.statement: Potential pressure: supporting a deployment model in which customer teams retain model-upgrade and provider-failover responsibility.

evidence.claim: Glean distinguishes Customer Key Auto from managed selection and assigns model upgrades/provider failover to the customer team.
The resolved August Azure OpenAI incident explicitly affected BYOK customers and documented a change of default model as a workaround.

cost_of_inaction.statement: Supported inference: affected customer teams may need to coordinate compatible alternatives and operational ownership during a provider problem. The incident is resolved; present gaps and applicability to any specific customer are unknown.

why_seller.statement: Configured OpenRouter model fallbacks could be evaluated for an eligible deployment if output quality, data policy and regional requirements permit. Existing mitigation and managed-key capabilities prevent an account-wide missing-failover claim.

items.name: Azure OpenAI
items.presence_evidence: A resolved August 31 first-party incident explicitly described BYOK customers using Azure OpenAI. This proves recent historical integration/use, not current configuration or an unresolved problem.

displacement_angle.statement: Supported inference: evaluate a compatible alternative only for an established unmet deployment requirement. Historical integration alone does not justify displacement, and the source documents an existing workaround.

tools.search_note: Only one tool met this pass’s concrete recent-use threshold. Other documented model choices are not treated as internal production usage.

initial_value_hypothesis.statement: Because Glean Agent Builder supports model choices across multi-step workflows and Customer Key deployments leave failover responsibility with customer teams, a specific eligible deployment may still have a compatibility or operating-boundary question worth testing. OpenRouter’s configurable model/provider routing could help test that question against an observable outcome such as successful compatible requests within the required latency and data-policy limits, but Glean’s existing AI Gateway and managed controls make generic replacement claims unsupported.
initial_value_hypothesis.initiative_or_situation: Glean Agent Builder expansion and the documented Universal Model Key versus Customer Key operating boundary
